title: 第5章 杨天佑第6章 商谈
content_zh:
离开前堂，祁澜又去了一趟爵府西侧的坊里，主持了大鱓身体的拆解、分配后，便回到爵府东厢院子里。
不多时，一大桶泛着红色光泽的汤水，便被运到了祁澜的院子里。
这是那大鱓的血，搭配爵府秘药制成的淬炼肉身的汤药。
黄鳝的血本有极重的腥味，此时被这草药压制了腥气，倒也不怎么难闻。
祁澜解开身上的衣衫，光着膀子走入桶中。
顿时，身躯表面便传来如针扎般的刺痛感。
不过他是人境巅峰的武士，距离地境仅差一步之遥，体魄强壮，反而适应得很快。
一时三刻后，汤中药效散去，祁澜也唤来家仆，用清水冲干净身体，擦拭后，便回了屋内休息。
“照着目前的进度，保守估计半年之内，应当能打通任督二脉，成就地境，若有更多灵药血食，还能更快一些。”
祁澜活动了一下有些酥麻的身子，在床上盘膝坐下，
祁澜盘膝坐下，内视己身。
随着心念一动，他仿佛能“看”到自己身上附着的几道玄妙光晕。
【天生蛮力】【灵思巧悟】【武道俊才】【根骨清灵】【渊游自在】……
“从孔武有力，到天生蛮力，可算是把这个天赋词条升级了。”
祁澜的嘴角抑制不住地上扬。
多次亲身搏杀精怪，终究是让原本孔武有力的词条，蜕变升级成天生蛮力。
自觉醒前世记忆以来，他便发现自己的身上多了几个词条，且这些词条似乎也会随着他所做的事情对外界的影响，人们对他印象的变化而发生变化。
渊游自在，一开始只是能泅善渡，武道俊才，最早也是从武道良才进化而来，灵思巧悟，是在他发明了黄冰糖之后出现的，而清灵根骨，则是一开始就有的，迄今没变过。
近期以来，他多次前往山野大泽，斩杀威胁治下领民的精怪，刻意展现出力量感，就连用的武器，都从普通的铜剑换成了重剑，给人留下了他力气又变大了许多的印象，使得孔武有力，终于升级为天生蛮力，一身气力，必能因此再涨几分。
哪怕距离杨家兄弟那变态般的身体天赋还有差距，但也绝对足够他和同阶武者，在力量上拉开差距。

再接下来，应该就是谋求资源，加快晋升地境，同时试着看，能不能找到能让他修道的路子。
毕竟自个身上有根骨清灵这个词条，肯定是有几分修行的天赋的，在这个真正存在仙神的世界，必然是得去试一试追求长生成仙。
修道之事，他当前只能指望灌江口杨家。
不管是那位天仙下凡的杨家主母，还是日后杨戬拜师的玉鼎真人，都是他目前唯一能抓住的线索。
而在谋求资源，加快晋升武道等级方面，多半也是落在这琥珀晶糖之上。
子爵邦国之内，虽然也能收集不少资源，但用的人也很多，他纵使是长溪世子，有很大的优待，也不可能放开了供应他。
真要获取资源，那还得看这琥珀晶糖能赚取多少利益，用来与其他部族交易。
巴蜀之地，面积广博，物产丰饶，像他们长溪部落这样的子、男邦国，有二十多个，再往上还有三侯六伯，巴蜀之地往外，还有西岐，过了西岐还有位于中原的大商和其他诸侯，能交换到的资源数不胜数。
当然，他们长溪部还没有行商天下的那个能力，但光是巴蜀之地的这些诸侯国，就已经是很大的市场了，若是琥珀晶糖能通行巴蜀，足以令他成为巴蜀之地排名前几的富豪。
而这东西也被他们作为贡品，选出上等货进贡商王。
content_en:
After leaving the front hall, Qi Lan went to the square on the west side of the palace again. After presiding over the dismantling and distribution of Da Yi's body, he returned to the east courtyard of the palace.
Not long after, a large bucket of red-glossy soup was transported to Qi Lan's yard.
This is the body-tempering decoction made from Dalu's blood and the secret medicine of the Duke's Palace.
The eel's blood originally had a very strong fishy smell, but now the herb suppressed the smell, so it wasn't that unpleasant at all.
Qi Lan unbuttoned his clothes and walked into the bucket shirtless.
Immediately, there was a tingling sensation like needles on the surface of the body.
However, he is a warrior at the peak of the human realm, only one step away from the earth realm. He is physically strong and adapts quickly.
After a moment and three quarters, the medicinal effects of the soup dissipated. Qi Lan also called his servant, rinsed his body with water, wiped it, and then went back to the house to rest.
"According to the current progress, it is conservatively estimated that within half a year, we should be able to open up the Rendu Meridian and achieve the realm. If there are more elixirs and blood food, it can be even faster."
Qi Lan moved his numb body and sat down cross-legged on the bed.
Qi Lan sat down cross-legged and looked inside.
As his mind moved, he seemed to be able to "see" several mysterious halos attached to his body.
[Natural brute force] [Ingenious thinking] [Martial arts talent] [Gengu Qingling] [Yuanyou Zizi]...
"From martial strength to natural brute strength, this talent entry can be regarded as an upgrade."
Qi Lan couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.
Fighting against monsters in person many times finally transformed the originally powerful entry into a natural brute force.
Since awakening his past life memories, he has discovered that there are several more entries in his body, and these entries seem to change with the impact of what he has done on the outside world and the changes in people's impression of him.
Yuanyou Zizi was only good at swimming at the beginning, martial arts talents first evolved from martial arts talents, clever thinking and enlightenment appeared after he invented yellow rock sugar, and Qingling root bones were there from the beginning and have not changed so far.
Recently, he went to the mountains and swamps many times to kill the monsters that threatened the people under his rule. He deliberately showed a sense of strength. Even the weapons he used were changed from ordinary copper swords to heavy swords, leaving people with the impression that his strength had become much stronger. Kong Wu was so powerful that he finally upgraded to a natural brute force. His physical strength would definitely increase a few points as a result.
Even if there is still a gap between the abnormal physical talent of the Yang brothers, it is definitely enough to widen the gap in strength between him and warriors of the same level.
The next step should be to seek resources to speed up his promotion to the realm, and at the same time try to see if he can find a way for him to practice Taoism.
After all, I have the entry "Gu Qing Ling" in my body, so I must have some talent for cultivation. In this world where immortals really exist, I must try to pursue immortality.
For the matter of cultivating Taoism, he could only rely on the Yang family of Guanjiangkou.
Whether it is the mistress of the Yang family who descended from heaven to earth, or the real person Yuding who Yang Jian will become his apprentice in the future, they are the only clues he can grasp at the moment.
When it comes to seeking resources and speeding up the martial arts level, most of them fall on this amber crystal candy.
Although the Viscount can collect a lot of resources in the country, there are also many people who use them. Even if he is the Crown Prince of Changxi and has great preferential treatment, it is impossible for him to freely supply them.
If you really want to obtain resources, it depends on how much profit you can earn from this amber crystal candy, which can be used to trade with other tribes.
The land of Bashu is vast in area and rich in products. There are more than twenty sub-states and male states like their Changxi tribe, and there are three princes and six uncles above them. Beyond the land of Bashu, there is Xiqi. Beyond Xiqi, there are the great merchants and other princes in the Central Plains. The resources that can be exchanged are countless.
Of course, their Changxi tribe does not yet have the ability to do business in the world, but the vassal states in Bashu alone are already a huge market.It is the amber crystal sugar that can travel through Bashu, which is enough to make him one of the top richest people in Bashu.
And this thing was also used as a tribute by them, and they selected the best products to pay tribute to the merchant king.
